Link containing bold text preserves formatting

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<a href=\"https://example.com\"><strong>Bold link</strong></a>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
